priorityList: Ensure Shadowform is active at all times.
Cast Halo on cooldown to activate Archon hero talent benefits.
Activate Voidform once Vampiric Touch and Shadow Word: Pain are applied to your targets.
Use Power Infusion and offensive trinkets while Voidform is active.
Cast Shadow Word: Madness if Insanity is low (deficit ≤ 35), if Mind Devourer procs, or when the target is nearly dead.
Cast Void Volley on cooldown during AoE encounters.
Cast Void Blast on your primary target, prioritizing targets with Shadow Word: Madness active.
Use Tentacle Slam to apply or refresh Vampiric Touch or if you are about to reach maximum charges.
Cast Void Torrent only when your primary DoTs (Vampiric Touch and Shadow Word: Pain) are active on the target.
Manually apply Vampiric Touch to spread the DoT to all targets (up to 12) if Tentacle Slam is unavailable.
Cast Mind Blast when you do not have a Mind Devourer proc active.
Cast Mind Flay: Insanity as a priority filler channel.
Use Shadow Word: Death on targets below 20% health or while your Shadowfiend, Mindbender, or Voidwraith is active.
Use Shadow Word: Pain to maintain the DoT or to trigger Invoked Nightmare if talented.
Channel Mind Flay as a filler, ensuring you complete at least 3 ticks before interrupting for a higher priority spell.
